name: Asahi
source:
Likes: Nothing
Hobby: Nothing

A youkai that serves the protagonist's grandfather.
He doesn't talk much and looks cold, but he has a kind and calm temperament.
He brought the protagonist to her grandfather at Ugetsu Village.
